summary: FP_VP_18 enclosure closing plate arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: FP_VP_18 is the drawing identifier for enclosure closing plate in Hensel's ENYSTAR enclosure and distribution-system STEP collection. A closing plate closes the selected opening in an enclosure assembly. It is different from a project-defined cable-entry plate that has been modified for penetrations.

For example, in an enclosure configuration with a separately selected closure part, use the FP_VP_18 reference to coordinate plate fixing, sealing interface and removal access. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as ENYSTAR_Verschlussplatten/FP_VP_18.stp for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep plate fixing, sealing interface and removal access visible in the layout.
